name: Woe Strider
oracle_text:
When this creature enters, create a 0/1 white Goat creature token.
Sacrifice another creature: Scry 1.
Escape—{3}{B}{B}, Exile four other cards from your graveyard. (You may cast this card from your graveyard for its escape cost.)
This creature escapes with two +1/+1 counters on it.
blocked_sentences: This creature escapes with two +1/+1 counters on it.

needs.what: a condition (e.g. `{"escaped": true}`) usable on a `self_enters_with_counters` replacement that is true only when this permanent's own resolution was a spell cast for the card's `graveyard_cost` (its escape cost) -- 702.138c-d "escapes with". Needs a per-cast stamp on the object, written by `stack._resolve_spell` from the stack item's flashback/graveyard_cost flag (not from `graveyard_permission`), and cleared on any arrival that is not that resolution, the way `cast_impending` is in `zones._enter_battlefield`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The closest is `all: [{"was_cast": true}, {"cast_from_graveyard": true}]` on the replacement, but `obj.cast_from_graveyard` is `item.flashback or item.graveyard_permission is not None`, so a Woe Strider cast from the graveyard under another permission (Muldrotha, Gisa, a `cast_from_graveyard` static) for its normal mana cost would also enter with the two counters, which 702.138c forbids. `evoked`, `cost_option` and `kicked` read other cost choices, none the graveyard_cost. The other three lines are expressible: goat_0_1_w via create_token on self_enters, a sacrifice-another-creature cost with scry 1, and Escape as graveyard_cost {mana, exile_from_graveyard {count 4, exclude_self}} plus graveyard_cast: graveyard
